claim: A Wikiloc hiking route climbs Bizkargi from Goikolexea (Larrabetzu) on a linear track of about 15.5 km with roughly 533 m of accumulated elevation gain.
Bizkargi is 555 m and is topped by the Santa Cruz (Santakrutz) hermitage with a stone bell-tower bearing a large stone cross, reachable in about half an hour on a forest path from the Alto de Morga.
quote: se accede por una pista forestal desde el Alto de Morga... la ermita tiene una espadaña de piedra rematada por una gran cruz de piedra

claim: Bizkargi (555 m) is a frequently climbed local peak in Bizkaia, part of a cluster with the adjacent Kurutziagagana (558 m) about 0.5 km away.
A shorter Bizkargi loop starts from the Alto de Morga pass between Larrabetzu and Muxika, linking Bizkargi with Arburu in about 8 km.

Mount Gorbea (1,482 m), highest peak in Bizkaia, is most easily climbed from Pagomakurre (about 490 m of gain, summit reached in roughly 1h45min) and is crowned by an 18-metre metal cross built in 1907.
quote: 1,482 metres above sea level... 490 metres... 1h 45min... an 18-metre-high metal cross on top

claim: The popular Gorbeia ascent from Pagomakurre is a round trip of about 12.2 km, the easiest and shortest route to the summit.
quote: The route of ascent to the Gorbeia from Pagomakurre has a total of 12.2 km

claim: The Vía Vieja de Lezama greenway is a 7.3 km cyclo-pedestrian path along the disused Bilbao–Lezama railway (closed 1908), including a 500 m tunnel, connecting Bilbao to Derio via Sondika, Zamudio and Loiu.
quote: will run for 7.3 km and will connect Bilbao and Derio, passing through Sondika, Zamudio and Loiu... includes a 500 m long tunnel

claim: Bizkaia's Provincial Council approved a 3.4 km Txorierri bidegorri linking Galdakao (Erletxe) to Larrabetzu, budgeted at around 11.9 million euros with an 18-month build, extending the cycle network toward the village.
Bizkaia is expanding its bidegorri network toward a target of 365 km by 2035, investing about 56 million euros in sustainable mobility in 2025.
quote: Bizkaia pedalea para alcanzar los 365 kilómetros de bidegorris en 2035

claim: An easy Sunday-style walk links Zamudio with Larrabetzu's Goikolexea neighbourhood over almost 12 km through meadows and farmhouses, making it a gentle valley option.

Larrabetzu's Goikolexea neighbourhood holds the Gothic Church of San Emeterio y San Celedonio, with one of Bizkaia's most notable Hispano-Flemish altarpieces, and the village historic centre is a declared Monumental Complex.
